briefdescription.para: Enter or leave delayed mode - in delayed mode smfree_delayed() doesn't free chunks but puts them into a pool.

detaileddescription.para: Allocate a piece of memory in the small allocator.
Find or create a mempool instance of the right size, and allocate the object on the pool.
If object is small enough to fit a stepped pool, finding the right pool for it is just a matter of bit shifts. Otherwise, look up a pool in the red-black factored pool tree.

briefdescription.para: Free memory chunk allocated by the small allocator.

detaileddescription.para: This boils down to finding the object's mempool and delegating to mempool_free().
If the pool becomes completely empty, and it's a factored pool, and the factored pool's cache is empty, put back the empty factored pool into the factored pool cache.

briefdescription.para: Free memory chunk allocated by the small allocator if not in snapshot mode, otherwise put to the delayed free list.

detaileddescription.para: Destroy the allocator and all allocated memory.
